lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with larger diameter clusters concentrated along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a regular matrix of anchor nodes across the lateral flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10 high-luminance circular blobs bounded within its silhouette, showing a less organized arrangement compared to the flank.
